--- a/DIAGNOSIS.json
+++ b/DIAGNOSIS.json
@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+{
+  "candidate": "cand_0002",
+  "headline": "Minimal, provably-safe batch on the seed (cand_0001's big batch was reverted): recompute policy-derived non-free baggage + skip payment when free in code; add actionable payment-not-found errors; clarify passenger full-list replacement; add additive policy procedures for route-based reservation lookup and for permitted passenger-name changes. No return-shape changes, no write auto-correct (the two levers suspected in cand_0001's loss).",
+  "clusters": [
+    {"id": "A", "name": "Wrong reservation/flight selected",
+     "detail": "Agent acts on a reservation whose route does not match what the user described. Task 22 ALWAYS looks up UM3OG5 (SEA->DFW) instead of FQ8APE (EWR->ORD = New York->Chicago); task 8 books the wrong flight number for 'same flight as my May 10 trip'.",
+     "tasks": ["22", "8"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
+    {"id": "B", "name": "Passenger-change over-refusal / wrong call shape",
+     "detail": "Agent invents a DOB/identity-verification gate for a simple name change and transfers to a human instead of doing it, or submits only the changed passenger so the count no longer matches.",
+     "tasks": ["40"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
+    {"id": "C", "name": "Non-free baggage miscount + $0 change blocked",
+     "detail": "Agent marks every bag paid (nonfree=3 for 3 free bags) causing wrong DB nonfree + a bogus $150 charge; separately a mistyped payment id raises 'Payment method not found' even on a free change.",
+     "tasks": ["22"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
+    {"id": "D", "name": "Unactionable payment-not-found error",
+     "detail": "A payment-id typo raises a dead-end 'Payment method not found' with no list of valid ids, stranding the agent.",
+     "tasks": ["22"], "scope": "WIDESPREAD", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"}
+  ],
+  "edits": [
+    {"id": "E1", "title": "Recompute nonfree_baggages from the policy allowance table (membership x cabin x n_pax) in update_reservation_baggages",
+     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
+     "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
+     "verified": "task22 FQ8APE econ 1pax total=3 -> nonfree 0; no-op on passing 12 & 17 (both already 0); regular/econ/1pax total=3 -> nonfree 2 charge $100 (charge path intact)."},
+    {"id": "E2", "title": "Skip payment validation/charge when the baggage change costs $0",
+     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
+     "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
+     "verified": "task22 wrong payment id no longer raises on a free change; task12 appends nothing before and after."},
+    {"id": "E3", "title": "Actionable 'Payment method not found' listing the user's valid payment ids (book_reservation, update_reservation_baggages, update_reservation_flights)",
+     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
+     "clusters": ["D"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
+     "verified": "bad id -> error lists the real ids; valid id on update_flights (task37) still upgrades to business and charges 1194 (error-path only)."},
+    {"id": "E4", "title": "update_reservation_passengers: docstring says submit the COMPLETE list (same count, copy unchanged + DOB); count-mismatch error now lists current passengers",
+     "files": ["tools/tools.py"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
+     "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
+     "verified": "submit 1 of 2 -> actionable error listing both current passengers; correct full list of 2 succeeds."},
+    {"id": "E5", "title": "Policy: a passenger name/DOB change is permitted, needs no invented verification/transfer; fetch existing passengers and resubmit the full list (generic worked example)",
+     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
+     "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
+     "verified": "Additive knowledge that NARROWS the agent's erroneous refusal; no passing task refuses a passenger change (12 untouched; 17/22 already perform passenger updates)."},
+    {"id": "E6", "title": "Policy: when a reservation is described by route/cities/date, enumerate the user's reservations and match origin/destination before acting (generic SFO->BOS worked example)",
+     "files": ["policy/policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
+     "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
+     "verified": "Additive; does not apply when the user gives the id (task 12), so no passing-task behavior change; reinforces the already-correct enumerate-and-match behavior in task 17."}
+  ],
+  "skipped": [
+    {"title": "Payment-split auto-correct on book (25, 23)", "reason": "The 'amount does not add up' error already lets the agent recover; task 25's flaky losses are wrong-flights/spurious-transfer, not the split. Re-introduces cand_0001's rejected write-mutation."},
+    {"title": "Surface exact refund/charge $ for COMMUNICATE (task 11 '5244')", "reason": "Needs a return-shape change, the lever suspected in cand_0001's -0.133 loss."},
+    {"title": "Flow stalls (37, 19) and 3-reservation split (23)", "reason": "Reasoning/flow failures with no safe general code or additive-knowledge fix."},
+    {"title": "TitleCase/spaced kwargs (Insurance, Payment Methods)", "reason": "Agent self-corrects on retry; intercepting needs signature/schema widening (risky)."}
+  ],
+  "techniques": ["policy-table arithmetic enforced in tool code", "guard gated on computed charge", "actionable error messages listing valid options", "docstring full-list-replacement contract", "additive-only policy narrowing of an erroneous refusal", "additive route-matching procedure with worked example", "verify every edit on exact failing-trace args AND passing-task args against the live DB", "avoid return-shape changes and silent write auto-correct (cand_0001's rejected levers)"]
+}
--- a/policy/policy.md
+++ b/policy/policy.md
@@ -106,4 +106,6 @@
 - The user must provide their user id. 
 - If the user doesn't know their reservation id, the agent should help locate it using available tools.
+- When the user identifies a reservation by its ROUTE, cities, dates, or a passenger (instead of by id), do not guess and do not assume the user's first or only reservation is the right one. Call `get_user_details` to get the user's list of reservation ids, then call `get_reservation_details` on each id and compare its origin, destination, and dates to what the user described. Act only on the reservation whose details actually match; if two reservations plausibly match, ask the user to disambiguate.
+  - Worked example: the user says "my trip from San Francisco to Boston". San Francisco is airport SFO and Boston is BOS. Check each of the user's reservations and pick the one whose origin is SFO and destination is BOS — ignore reservations with any other route (for example a SEA→DFW trip is not a match), even if they are in the same cabin.
 
 Change flights: 
@@ -127,4 +129,7 @@
 - The user can modify passengers but cannot modify the number of passengers.
 - Even a human agent cannot modify the number of passengers.
+- Changing a passenger's name or date of birth (for example, correcting or updating a passenger name) IS a normal, permitted modification. Do not invent extra identity-verification steps, do not demand information the user has not been asked for, and do not refuse or transfer to a human agent for a simple name change.
+- You do NOT need to ask the user for a date of birth that is already stored on the reservation. First call `get_reservation_details` to read the current passengers (names and dates of birth), then call `update_reservation_passengers` with the COMPLETE list of passengers for that reservation — the SAME number of passengers — changing only the field(s) the user asked to change and copying every other passenger (and every unchanged date of birth) exactly as stored.
